sanskrit:
श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श‍ृणुयादपि यो नरः ।
सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥ १८-७१॥
iast:
śraddhāvānanasūyaśca śṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ
so’pi muktaḥ śubhām̐llokān prāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām 18-71
translation: That man also, who hears this, full of faith and free from malice, he too, liberated, shall attain to the happy worlds of those righteous deeds.
